# Runner SDK (generated by A)

Dogfood: **A** (`a-sdk-mcp-gen`) generates TS / Python / Go clients from
[`../openapi/runner.openapi.json`](../openapi/runner.openapi.json).

```bash
# from portfolio root
make dogfood-a-c
# or
bash scripts/generate-runner-sdk.sh
```

Output lands in `generated/` (gitignored; regenerate in CI / `make local-mvp`).
